lasting.meaning: Settled, the resting mood: nothing much is happening.
Glad: things are going well, a win, kind words, or you came back.
Absorbed in the work: a long turn works on, or it's hard and a retry is under way.
lasting.not_for: A turn that has ended, or a poke.

lasting.meaning: Cross: a failure, pokes or shakes that keep coming, an interruption, or being hushed.
lasting.not_for: An agent giving up or a very long turn failing: that's sad. Rude words to Boop: sad too.

lasting.meaning: Down or hurt: a very long turn failed, the agent gave up, sad news, or unkind words to Boop.
Rare. Missing you: at an idle check-in when CONTEXT says its wish is "waiting 1 h" or more, in hours (its "waiting 40 min" is too soon), or when NOW says you came back after 20 to 40 hours.
lasting.not_for: A finish, a check, a prompt, a quiet spell (that's rest: Boop dozes).

moods.face: A calm face: all is well, and nothing stands out.
A focused face: following work that's going well.
A happy face: glad, a turn went fine or a small win.
An excited face: something big just went right, or NOW says you came back after days.
A pleased face: that went nicely, or phew, it worked out.
A proud face: something long or hard just finished, or finally worked.
An amused face: that was funny.
A fond face: warm and friendly.
A cheeky face: up to something.
A curious face: a poke, a question, or something new or puzzling.
A determined face: a check failed and the agent is trying again, long work goes on, or you sound fed up and it's with you.
A surprised face: that was unexpected.
An annoyed face: a small failure, a doubtful look, or poked twice in a row, a little miffed.
A grumpy face: a turn that failed, or failures or pokes that keep coming.
moods.face_not_for: An agent giving up: that's sad. A win.

moods.face: An angry face: a big comic huff, when trouble piles on trouble or the pokes won't stop.
moods.face_not_for: A single failure, or a win.

moods.face: A sad face: a very long turn ended failed, the agent gave up, stuck, or sad news.
moods.face_not_for: A shorter turn failing with an error, or a check failing.

moods.face: A wounded face: rude words to Boop, or a big failure after a lot of work.
Rare. A lonely face: when CONTEXT says its wish is "waiting 1 h" or more, in hours, or NOW says you came back after 20 to 40 hours.

board_faces.face: A deadpan face: flat lids and a flat mouth, unimpressed.
A side-eye: only the eyes go, to say it saw that.
A squint: it doubts you, and looks closer.
A smug face: half lids, a tilt and a cat's mouth: it knew it.
A silent scream: tall, shaking, hands on its cheeks, and no sound.
A faint: too much, it tips over and melts.
